content: Hello, thank you for contacting Amazon Support. My name is Tyler. I see here there's an issue with your recent order, would it be alright if I confirm a few details to assist you promptly?
Uh, sure, that's okay. What do you need to know?
Thank you. Just so I can pull up the correct information, could you please confirm your full name and the phone number linked to your Amazon account?
Yeah, it's Jordan Lee and my phone is 555-259-1986.

Thank you, Jordan. I appreciate you verifying that. I do see a notification related to your last order, there's a temporary hold due to an unverified customs clearance fee. It's a standard Amazon procedure for some international shipments.
Oh, I didn't know that was a thing. Is my order in trouble?

No need to worry, it's a routine step, and I'm here to help you resolve it. Once the fee is verified, your item will be released right away. This just helps us ensure compliance with new customs regulations.
Okay. What do I have to do? I really need that package.
Absolutely, we'll get this sorted as quickly as possible. I'll just need to transfer you to our senior verification officer, who's authorized to process customs payments. Would that be alright?
Yeah, that's fine. Thank you.
Hi Jordan, this is Ms. Patel from Amazon Verification. I understand you're needing assistance with the customs clearance on your order. Can I confirm the delivery address for accuracy?
Yeah, it's 912 Parkview Lane, Apt 2B, Merrivale.
Thank you. For your security, can you also share the last four digits of the card you used for your purchase?
Um, it's 4122.

Perfect, thank you so much. According to our policy, the customs fee must be paid before we complete the shipment. The fee is $148. This is a refundable charge, Amazon will credit it back to your account within 24 hours after delivery.
Oh, okay. How do I pay that? Do I just use my card?

Actually, for customs and regulatory fees, Amazon only accepts payment via Amazon Gift Card or via our partnered payment service, Zelle, due to security protocols. I can walk you through whichever is easiest.
I think I can do a gift card. Is that really the only way?
Yes, for these specific fees, it's the only accepted method. I promise, as soon as the fee is processed, you'll receive a confirmation and your package will be immediately released.
Alright, I guess I can get an Amazon gift card. What do I do next?

You simply need to purchase an Amazon Gift Card, either online or from a local store, for $148. When you have the card, please scratch off the back and provide me with the claim code so I can apply it directly to your customs file.
Okay, I can do that. Do I need to do it now?

Yes, it's important to complete this today, as the system will automatically cancel your order and restrict your Amazon account if the customs fee isn't received within 24 hours. But once you send the code, I'll take care of everything for you.
Oh, I didn't realize it was that strict. I'll get the card as soon as possible.

Thank you, Jordan. I understand this can be unexpected, but you're doing exactly what's needed. Just message me the code as soon as you have it, and I'll confirm once the payment is processed and your account is fully secure.
Alright. I'll go to the store now and let you know once I have it.

Wonderful. I'll stay on the line if you'd like, or you can reply here when you're ready. Remember, if the payment isn't made today, Amazon may need to escalate the issue and could temporarily lock your account for security.
Okay, I'll hurry so that doesn't happen. Thank you for helping me.
Of course, Jordan, I'm here to help you every step of the way. Just let me know when you have the gift card, and I'll finalize everything for you right away.
